common.adminOnlyMessage: This section is only for platform administrators.

config.title: Platform configuration
config.subtitle: Dynamic ad pricing - instant changes
config.intro: Edit the rates we charge for ads. Each change refreshes the backend cache instantly (maximum 60 s propagation). Values apply to new campaigns; already active campaigns keep the price they were created with.

impression.label: Cost per impression
impression.description: Charged to the advertiser each time their card appears in the featured ranking. Calibrate it with the target CPM (cost per thousand impressions) in mind.

click.label: Cost per click
click.description: Charged when the buyer clicks a promoted card and opens the conversation. This is the highest-value event; calibrate it higher than impressions.

minBudget.label: Minimum campaign budget
minBudget.description: Advertisers cannot create a campaign below this amount. It helps avoid token campaigns with no traction.

images.title: Site images
images.subtitle: User-facing image CMS
images.intro: Change user-facing images (404, hero, banners, logos, etc.) without redeploying. Changes propagate to all users in about 10 minutes.
